tent.name: Tent
tent.desc: Rest on the world map. Restores the party.

remedy.name: Remedy
remedy.desc: Cures every ailment, berserk and stop included.

rage_tonic.name: Rage Tonic
rage_tonic.desc: Berserks an ally for 3 rounds: ATK ×1.5, but they attack on their own.

bomb.name: Ember Bomb
bomb.desc: Deals fire damage to all foes.

star_bomb.name: Star Bomb
star_bomb.desc: Bursts with holy light on all foes.

ember_core.name: Ember Core
ember_core.desc: Still warm. From fire-born monsters of Emberdeep and the Ashen Isle.

frost_crystal.name: Frost Crystal
frost_crystal.desc: Never melts. From the beasts of the frozen north.

sun_gold.name: Sun Gold
sun_gold.desc: Tomb gold that remembers the desert sun.

star_shard.name: Star Shard
star_shard.desc: A splinter of fallen sky, from the Starfall Observatory.

dusk_silk.name: Dusk Silk
dusk_silk.desc: Shadow, woven thin. From creatures of the Hollow Night.

abyss_ash.name: Abyss Ash
abyss_ash.desc: Ash from the Crownfall Abyss. It drinks lamplight.

minnow.name: Brook Minnow
minnow.desc: Tiny and wriggly. Mittens would approve.

trout.name: River Trout
trout.desc: Speckled and strong. Found in fresh water.

goldcarp.name: Golden Carp
goldcarp.desc: A rare gold-scaled carp from Brightwater's pond.

seabass.name: Sea Bass
seabass.desc: A fine catch from the open sea.

mackerel.name: Silver Mackerel
mackerel.desc: Flashes like a coin in the water.

eel.name: Harbor Eel
eel.desc: Slippery. Port Halden's fishwives fry them whole.

icepike.name: Ice Pike
icepike.desc: A cold, toothy hunter from Frostmere.

frostchar.name: Frost Char
frostchar.desc: Its belly glows faintly, like the northern lights.

sturgeon.name: Snow Sturgeon
sturgeon.desc: Ancient and enormous. Rarely seen in Frostmere.

catfish.name: Oasis Catfish
catfish.desc: Whiskered and wise. It has seen many caravans.

pearlfish.name: Mirage Pearlfish
pearlfish.desc: Some say it isn't really there. It is.

embereel.name: Ember Eel
embereel.desc: Lives in the warm ash-shallows of the Ashen Isle.

koi.name: Lantern Koi
koi.desc: A legend. It glows like a lit Lantern.

locket.name: Nell's Locket
locket.desc: A silver locket with a tiny painted gull inside.

stonebrand.name: Stonebrand
stonebrand.desc: Orrin's ancestral forge-hammer. Heavier than it looks.

sun_seal.name: Sun Seal
sun_seal.desc: The royal seal of Mirage. It opens the First King's tomb.

star_chart.name: Star Chart
star_chart.desc: Wren's chart. One constellation is circled: the Fifth Flame.

lastlight_lamp.name: Lamp of Lastlight
lastlight_lamp.desc: Lit from Lastlight's thousand-year fire. The Abyss's mist fears it.

fathers_ledger.name: Father's Ledger
fathers_ledger.desc: Arin's father's rounds: twelve roadside lamps on the four roads, all dark now.

grimoire.name: Mother's Grimoire
grimoire.desc: Lyra and Selene's mother's book of flames. The last page is a riddle.

priest_letter.name: The Last Letter
priest_letter.desc: From the drowned priesthood of the Sea Mother. It names a grotto on the east coast.

debt_note.name: Vane's Marker
debt_note.desc: Kestrel's old debt to the Undercity Guild, with interest. A lot of interest.

fishing_rod.name: Old Fishing Rod
fishing_rod.desc: Face water and press Enter to fish. Stand by the shore, a pond or a pier.

phoenix_charm.name: Phoenix Charm
phoenix_charm.desc: DEF +6. Revives the wearer once per battle. Arena prize.

lantern_crown.name: Lantern Crown
lantern_crown.desc: All +20, regen, +50% EXP, no ailments. Grand Champion's prize.

fifth_flame.name: The Fifth Flame
fifth_flame.desc: All stats +15. Regen. Prevents all ailments.

eclipse_mantle.name: Eclipse Mantle
eclipse_mantle.desc: DEF +24, MAG +24. Revives once per battle. Prevents silence.

nightglass.name: Nightglass Locket
nightglass.desc: All +18. Prevents sleep. A drop of gentle night.

thief_gloves.name: Thief's Gloves
thief_gloves.desc: SPD +10. Rare steals are twice as likely. Rare steal: Guildmaster Vane.

starlit_cloak.name: Starlit Cloak
starlit_cloak.desc: DEF +20, MAG +20. Prevents sleep and slow. Rare steal: Astral Wyrm.

kings_signet.name: King's Signet
kings_signet.desc: ATK +18, MAG +18. Rare steal: the Hollow King.

sun_circlet.name: Sun Circlet
sun_circlet.desc: MAG +16. Prevents blind and silence. Rare steal: Ozymar.

scholar_monocle.name: Scholar's Monocle
scholar_monocle.desc: MAG +14. +25% EXP. Prevents blind. Sable's reward.

bestiary_seal.name: Bestiary Seal
bestiary_seal.desc: All +14. Rare steals twice as likely. Sable's reward for every creature.

tide_chart.name: Tessaly's Chart
tide_chart.desc: An old sea chart in the Abbot's hand. Four patches of black water are circled.

moth_whistle.name: Moth Whistle
moth_whistle.desc: Old Ivy's bone whistle. Blow it at a lit roadside lamp and a lanternmoth comes down to carry you.

tmap1.name: Map: Smuggler's Cove
tmap1.desc: X marks a beach south of Port Halden, where the causeway runs out to the Sunken Shrine. "Dig at the third palm." There are no palms.

tmap2.name: Map: The Cold Cairn
tmap2.desc: A cairn in the snowfields between Frostmere and Ironhold. Someone has drawn a very cold-looking face.

tmap3.name: Map: Dune Sea
tmap3.desc: Deep in the Sunscar, south of Mirage and west of the Tomb. "Where the sand sings at noon."

tmap4.name: Map: Hollow Root
tmap4.desc: At the edge of the Whisperwood, north of Brightwater. The ink smells of moss.

tmap5.name: Map: Ash and Gold
tmap5.desc: The Ashen Isle, south of Lastlight. Charred at the edges. Somebody wanted this burned.

deep_pearl.name: Deep Pearl
deep_pearl.desc: A black pearl from the sea floor. It glows when you aren't looking at it.

coral_blade.name: Coral Blade
coral_blade.desc: Red coral over steel. It never rusts.

pearl_staff.name: Pearl Staff
pearl_staff.desc: A black pearl that holds a flame underwater.

reef_mace.name: Reef Mace
reef_mace.desc: Struck from Nerith's old temple bell.

eel_fang.name: Eel Fang
eel_fang.desc: A knife that bends like an eel. It always finds the gap.

abyss_orb.name: Abyss Orb
abyss_orb.desc: Black water, held in a glass ball. Something swims in it.

nacre_mail.name: Nacre Mail
nacre_mail.desc: Mother-of-pearl plates. Rainbow-bright and very hard.

kelp_robe.name: Kelp Robe
kelp_robe.desc: Woven sea-silk. It is never quite dry.

shark_garb.name: Sharkskin Garb
shark_garb.desc: Rough one way, smooth the other.

abyssal_plate.name: Abyssal Plate
abyssal_plate.desc: Forged by Orrin from deep pearls. It hums at low tide.

pearl_veil.name: Pearl Veil
pearl_veil.desc: Forged by Orrin — strung, really. A thousand tiny pearls.

marlin_garb.name: Marlin Garb
marlin_garb.desc: Forged by Orrin. Fast enough to outswim a marlin.

siren_scale.name: Siren Scale
siren_scale.desc: MAG +18. Prevents sleep and silence. Rare steal: Sirens of Nerith.

pressure_ring.name: Pressure Ring
pressure_ring.desc: DEF +14, HP +300. Made to survive the deep.

lucky_coin.name: Lucky Doubloon
lucky_coin.desc: All +6. +50% gold from battles. Buried treasure.

admiral_hat.name: Admiral's Hat
admiral_hat.desc: SPD +10, DEF +8. Halves random encounters. Buried treasure.

tidecrown.name: Crown of Nerith
tidecrown.desc: All +16. Prevents slow and sleep. The last king's crown, freely given.

tidesong.name: Tidesong
tidesong.desc: All +26. Regen. No ailments. The sea remembers you now.

jokers_lantern.name: Joker's Lantern
jokers_lantern.desc: All +10. Rare steals twice as likely. Every card player in the world, beaten.

night_cloak.name: Night Cloak
night_cloak.desc: ATK +10, SPD +16. Prevents blind and stop. The Guild's finest.

sunset_opal.name: Sunset Opal
sunset_opal.desc: A fist-sized opal the colour of a desert evening. The Guild says it was theirs first.

heartlight.name: Heartlight
heartlight.desc: All +20. Revives once per battle. No ailments. Five lights, one lantern.

endless_wick.name: Endless Wick
endless_wick.desc: All +14, HP +400, slowly heals in battle. It has burned at the bottom of the well for a thousand years.

twin_crown.name: Crown of Dusk & Dawn
twin_crown.desc: All +25. Regen. No ailments. Both halves of the first crown, at peace.

nocturne.name: Nocturne
nocturne.desc: Plays the dark like an instrument.

pharaoh_mace.name: Gilded Mace
pharaoh_mace.desc: Gold from the First King's tomb.

ashsteel_blade.name: Ashsteel Blade
ashsteel_blade.desc: Quenched in the Ashen Isle's cinders.

oathblade.name: Lamplighter's Oath
oathblade.desc: Forged by Orrin. It burns brighter in the dark.

phoenix_staff.name: Phoenix Staff
phoenix_staff.desc: Forged by Orrin. Its flame relights itself.

tidecaller.name: Tidecaller
tidecaller.desc: Forged by Orrin. The sea answers it.

gloamfang.name: Gloamfang
gloamfang.desc: Forged by Orrin. Cuts twice for every swing you see.

sunbearer.name: Sunbearer
sunbearer.desc: Lit from twelve roadside lamps. Arin's father's blade, reforged.

hearthstaff.name: Hearthstaff
hearthstaff.desc: Lyra's mother's staff. It is always warm.

abbots_bell.name: Abbot's Bell
abbots_bell.desc: The drowned priesthood's bell. It rings like the tide coming in.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocket's Prize
pickpocket.desc: Vane's own knife. Kestrel says she found it.

duskstar.name: Duskstar
duskstar.desc: The first star after sunset, held in Selene's hand.

evenstar.name: Evenstar
evenstar.desc: Forged by Orrin. The first star of evening.

ash_robe.name: Ash Robe
ash_robe.desc: Woven by the weavers of Lastlight.

ash_garb.name: Ash Garb
ash_garb.desc: Grey as smoke, and as hard to catch.

ember_plate.name: Emberforged Plate
ember_plate.desc: Forged by Orrin with a heart of embers.

night_weave.name: Night Weave
night_weave.desc: Forged by Orrin — well, sewn. He insists it counts.

gloam_leathers.name: Gloam Leathers
gloam_leathers.desc: Forged by Orrin. Silent as a held breath.
